claims.claim: Subject to stockholder approval, 5% of Anthropic's shares will be committed to the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund.
An additional 2% may be added at the board's discretion for every 50% increase in company value above a set, undisclosed baseline.
The fund is a wholly-owned LLC rather than a 501(c)(3), and its Anthropic equity will not be used for lobbying or political giving.
Combined with founder and employee pledges, roughly 20% of Anthropic shares will be dedicated to the public good.
Anthropic's Series H valued the company at $965 billion post-money.
Anthropic's Series G valued the company at $380 billion post-money.
Investors at Anthropic's investor day discussed an IPO valuation around $1.5 trillion versus roughly $2 trillion previously expected.
Delaware DGCL 160(c) bars voting and quorum counting of a corporation's shares held by an entity it majority-controls.
Under US GAAP, parent shares held by a subsidiary are not treated as outstanding and are reflected as treasury shares.
Private foundations must distribute about 5% of non-charitable assets annually (IRC 4942); an LLC has no such rule.
Forbes estimates each of Anthropic's seven co-founders owns just over 1.7% of the company.
Bloomberg's wealth index estimates each co-founder owns less than 1% of Anthropic.
Anthropic's careers page offers optional equity donation matching at a 1:1 ratio up to 25% of an equity grant.
Anthropic's employee charity match generated more than $660 million of non-cash expense between October 2025 and March 2026.
Trust-appointed directors became a majority of Anthropic's seven-member board with Vas Narasimhan's appointment.
The draft S-1 gives a Founder LLC a single Class F share with 50.1% of voting power on key matters, with the Trust electing four directors.
Tesla's 2025 CEO award comprises 12 tranches of 35,311,992 shares tied to market-cap milestones up to $8.5 trillion.
The OpenAI Foundation holds a 26% stake valued around $130 billion plus a warrant if OpenAI Group's share price rises more than tenfold after 15 years.
US unemployment insurance benefits totalled about $36.9 billion in 2025 per BEA data.
Anthropic committed $200 million to an Economic Futures Research Fund primarily funding projects in the $5-30 million range.
NYC Comptroller asked Anthropic to pause its IPO citing a gap between control and accountability.
The OpenAI Foundation pledged $25 billion without a time frame and granted $40.5 million by December 2025.
The 5% stake is worth about $48.25 billion at the $965 billion Series H post-money valuation.
assumptions: Post-money preferred price applied to a common-equivalent block; no common discount applied.

claims.claim: The 5% stake would be worth about $75 billion at the ~$1.5 trillion IPO valuation investors discussed.
assumptions: $1.5T is anonymous-source investor talk, not a price range.

claims.claim: The Series H mark is about 2.54 times the Series G valuation.
assumptions: Both marks are post-money preferred prices.

claims.claim: Seven co-founders at about 1.7% each pledging 80% implies roughly 9.5% of Anthropic.
assumptions: Forbes estimate of equal ~1.7% stakes for all seven co-founders; pledge applies to the full stake.

claims.claim: A 5% annual payout on a $48.25 billion corpus is about 6.5% of 2025 US unemployment insurance outlays.
assumptions: Hypothetical 5% payout rate; the LLC has no payout rule.

claims.claim: Under arithmetic +50% steps, a 10x rise above baseline implies a fund stake of 41% if every tranche is granted.
assumptions: Arithmetic +50% steps; percentage-point interpretation; every discretionary tranche granted.
